answer:
The money lasts only just until payday.

After paying all bills due before the next salary on 24.12.2026, CHF 124.96 will remain on your Privatkonto on 23.12., giving you exactly CHF 4.63 per day for the remaining 27 days. According to the board data, without receiving the expected CHF 1'050.00 from Patrick Rüegg, this is extremely tight.

It is on your board already.
